data.title: doc show DOC-N:from-to puts the lines in body and adds section {from, to, lines}
data.why: The caller that follows a search or hook reference already reads document.body; giving it the lines it asked for there means no new field to learn, and bytes stays the whole size so the rest can still be judged. Measured on the hook's own references for the 25 golden questions: ~340 tokens against ~2,300, median ratio 0.17.
data.rejected: A separate section.text with body left out: every existing reader of doc show --json would find no body and fail; The whole body plus the range to cut client-side: the cost this task exists to remove
